successors.name: United State of Rajasthan
successors.text: the four princely states Alwar, Bharatpur, Dholpur and Karauli, 'merged ... to form the Matsya Union'

ledger.x: 18 March 1948: the Matsya Union is formed.
18 March 1948: Alwar joins the Matsya Union.
18 March 1948: Bharatpur joins the Matsya Union.
18 March 1948: Dholpur joins the Matsya Union.
18 March 1948: Karauli joins the Matsya Union.
15 May 1949: the Matsya Union merges into Greater Rajasthan.

certainty.note: The union's edges are the surveyed boundaries of the four princely states; the dossier draws them as circles of the pages' areas, so the outlines are approximations to be replaced with district outlines.
